next:wr:690.hint: 彼は決して愚か者ではない
next:wr:690.answer: He is by no means a fool.
next:wr:690.fullSentence: He is by no means a fool.
next:wr:690.explanation: by no means『決して〜ない』の別例。
next:wr:690.relatedInfo: in no senseなども同じグループ。

next:wr:692.hint: 彼は決して嘘をつくような人ではない
next:wr:692.answer: He is the last person to tell a lie.
next:wr:692.fullSentence: He is the last person to tell a lie.
next:wr:692.explanation: the last A to V『決してVしないA』(最も〜しそうにない)。
next:wr:692.relatedInfo: 最上級を使った強い否定表現。

next:wr:694.hint: 彼の説明は決して満足のいくものではない
next:wr:694.answer: His explanation is far from satisfactory.
next:wr:694.fullSentence: His explanation is far from satisfactory.
next:wr:694.explanation: far from A『決してAではない』(=not at all)。

next:wr:696.hint: 彼は読みきれないほどの漫画を持っている
next:wr:696.answer: He has more comic books than he can read.
next:wr:696.fullSentence: He has more comic books than he can read.
next:wr:696.explanation: more A than S can V『Sが〜できる以上にA』(比較級を用いた否定的強調)。
next:wr:696.relatedInfo: 『読める量を超えている』というニュアンス。

next:wr:698.hint: 降れば必ず土砂降りだ(悪いことは重なるものだ)
next:wr:698.answer: It never rains but it pours.
next:wr:698.fullSentence: It never rains but it pours.
next:wr:698.explanation: ことわざ。never...but構文『Vすれば必ず…する』。
next:wr:698.relatedInfo: 悪いことが重なる状況を表すことわざ。

next:wr:700.hint: たとえあるにしても彼の回復の見込みはほとんどない
next:wr:700.answer: There is little hope, if any, of his recovery.
next:wr:700.fullSentence: There is little hope, if any, of his recovery.
next:wr:700.explanation: if any『たとえあるにしても〜はほとんどない』。

next:wr:702.hint: 彼はどちらかといえば無愛想、いや無礼だ
next:wr:702.answer: He is unfriendly, if anything, rude.
next:wr:702.fullSentence: He is unfriendly, if anything, rude.
next:wr:702.explanation: if anything『どちらかといえば / たとえあるとしても』。
next:wr:702.relatedInfo: 前述の内容をより強い表現で言い換えるときに使う。

next:wr:704.hint: 私に手紙を送ってきたのはジャックだったのか?(強調構文の疑問文)
next:wr:704.answer: Was it Jack that sent me the letter?
next:wr:704.fullSentence: Was it Jack that sent me the letter?
next:wr:704.explanation: 強調構文の疑問文形: Was it A that ~?『〜したのはAだったのか』。
next:wr:704.relatedInfo: It was Jack that sent me the letter. の疑問文形。

next:wr:706.hint: 彼は怒った時にだけ大声で話す(〜して初めて…する)
next:wr:706.answer: It is only when he is angry that he speaks loudly.
next:wr:706.fullSentence: It is only when he is angry that he speaks loudly.
next:wr:706.explanation: It is only when~ that…『〜してはじめて…する』。

next:wr:708.hint: 私をだれだと思っているんだ
next:wr:708.answer: What on earth did you take me for?
next:wr:708.fullSentence: What on earth did you take me for?
next:wr:708.explanation: What on earth ~?『一体全体〜』(疑問詞を強調)。take A for B『AをBだと思う』。
next:wr:708.relatedInfo: on earthは疑問詞を強める挿入句。

next:wr:710.hint: 彼は私に忙しいと言った(伝えた)
next:wr:710.answer: He told me that he was busy.
next:wr:710.fullSentence: He told me that he was busy.
next:wr:710.explanation: S told me that ~『SはOに〜と言った(伝えた)』。
next:wr:710.relatedInfo: tellはSVOOの形をとる伝達動詞。

next:wr:712.hint: 彼女は私に窓を開けるように頼んだ
next:wr:712.answer: She asked me to open the window.
next:wr:712.fullSentence: She asked me to open the window.
next:wr:712.explanation: S asked O to V『SはOに〜するように頼んだ』。
next:wr:712.relatedInfo: 否定はasked O not to Vの形。

next:wr:714.hint: その辞書をどこで買ったのか尋ねた
next:wr:714.answer: He asked me where I had bought the dictionary.
next:wr:714.fullSentence: He asked me where I had bought the dictionary.
next:wr:714.explanation: 疑問詞疑問文の間接話法は疑問詞をそのまま使い、平叙文の語順にする。
next:wr:714.relatedInfo: buyがhad boughtになるのは時制の一致。

next:wr:716.hint: 彼は私に座って、そして聞くように言った
next:wr:716.answer: He told me to sit down and listen.
next:wr:716.fullSentence: He told me to sit down and listen.
next:wr:716.explanation: S told O to V1 and (to) V2『SはOに〜し、そして〜するように言った』。2つ目のtoは省略できる。
next:wr:716.relatedInfo: listenの前のtoは省略されることが多い。

next:wr:718.hint: 直接話法のtheseは、間接話法ではthoseになる
next:wr:718.answer: He said that he liked those.
next:wr:718.fullSentence: He said that he liked those.
next:wr:718.explanation: 直接話法のtheseは、間接話法ではthoseになる。
next:wr:718.relatedInfo: thisがthatになるのと同じ理屈。

next:wr:720.hint: 直接話法のnowは、間接話法ではthenになる
next:wr:720.answer: He said that he would do it then.
next:wr:720.fullSentence: He said that he would do it then.
next:wr:720.explanation: 直接話法のnowは、間接話法ではthenになる。
next:wr:720.relatedInfo: 時の副詞も話法転換で変化する代表例。

next:wr:721.hint: 直接話法のtodayは、間接話法ではthat dayになる
next:wr:721.answer: He said that he was busy that day.
next:wr:721.fullSentence: He said that he was busy that day.
next:wr:721.explanation: 直接話法のtodayは、間接話法ではthat dayになる。
next:wr:721.relatedInfo: 時を表す語も話法転換で変化する。

next:wr:723.hint: 直接話法のlast nightは、間接話法ではthe night beforeになる
next:wr:723.answer: He said that he had called me the night before.
next:wr:723.fullSentence: He said that he had called me the night before.
next:wr:723.explanation: 直接話法のlast nightは、間接話法ではthe night before/the previous nightになる。
next:wr:723.relatedInfo: yesterdayの言い換えと同じパターン。

next:wr:725.hint: 直接話法のnext weekは、間接話法ではthe next weekになる
next:wr:725.answer: He said that he would finish it the next week.
next:wr:725.fullSentence: He said that he would finish it the next week.
next:wr:725.explanation: 直接話法のnext weekは、間接話法ではthe next week/the following weekになる。
next:wr:725.relatedInfo: next monthやnext yearも同様に変化する。

next:wr:728.hint: 応募者全員が面接に受かったわけではない(部分否定)
next:wr:728.answer: Not all of the applicants passed the interview.
next:wr:728.fullSentence: Not all of the applicants passed the interview.
next:wr:728.explanation: not~all / not~every『3人以上を対象とした部分否定「すべてが〜というわけではない」』。

next:wr:730.hint: 両親とも式典に出席できたわけではない(部分否定)
next:wr:730.answer: Not both of my parents could attend the ceremony.
next:wr:730.fullSentence: Not both of my parents could attend the ceremony.
next:wr:730.explanation: not~both『2人を対象とした部分否定「両方とも〜というわけではない」』。

next:wr:732.hint: 高価なものが必ずしも良いというわけではない
next:wr:732.answer: Expensive things are not necessarily good.
next:wr:732.fullSentence: Expensive things are not necessarily good.
next:wr:732.explanation: not necessarily『必ずしも〜というわけではない』。

next:wr:734.hint: 彼は少しもがっかりしなかった(全体否定)
next:wr:734.answer: He was not disappointed in the least.
next:wr:734.fullSentence: He was not disappointed in the least.
next:wr:734.explanation: not... in the least(= not... at all)『少しも〜でない』。

next:wr:736.hint: 彼の主張を裏付ける証拠はまったくなかった
next:wr:736.answer: There was no evidence whatever to support his claim.
next:wr:736.fullSentence: There was no evidence whatever to support his claim.
next:wr:736.explanation: not + 名詞 + whatever / whatsoever『まったく〜ない』。
next:wr:736.relatedInfo: no+名詞+whateverの形で強い否定を表す。

next:wr:738.hint: 彼は決して友人を裏切らない人だ
next:wr:738.answer: He is the last person who would betray his friends.
next:wr:738.fullSentence: He is the last person who would betray his friends.
next:wr:738.explanation: the last person who would do『決して〜しない人』。
next:wr:738.relatedInfo: the last A to do とほぼ同じ構造。
